workingPopulation: Households with at least one person at Pension Credit qualifying age, potentially eligible but not in receipt; no individuals identified, recruited or contacted
problem: Measurement of confirmed Pension Credit receipt and equitable access; avoid duplicating established Our Newham Money services

sourceItems.population: All people in income-deprived households, not specifically pensioners
sourceItems.originLicense: OGL v3.0; reuse of specific figures subject to original publication notices
sourceItems.limitations: Area income deprivation does not identify Pension Credit eligibility, claimant households, individual poverty or a causal outcome.

sourceItems.population: Pensioner benefit units/families estimated eligible nationally
sourceItems.limitations: National survey-based benefit-unit estimate, not Newham or a locally valid claimant denominator; cannot be treated as Newham take-up.

sourceItems.metric: Residents supported to claim Pension Credit by Our Newham Money
sourceItems.population: Residents supported by local service; independently verified eligible denominator not supplied
sourceItems.originLicense: Publisher reuse/redistribution rights not independently reviewed; reference only
sourceItems.limitations: Support to claim is a service output, not proof of a unique confirmed award, eligibility, causal additionality or the rate of take-up. Subcohorts may overlap other council publications.

sourceItems.metric: Additional income attributed by council to supported Pension Credit claims
sourceItems.population: Same council programme report as 220 claim-support output
sourceItems.originLicense: Publisher reuse/redistribution rights not independently reviewed; reference only
sourceItems.limitations: Council-reported additional income is neither HPI impact nor audited counterfactual incremental welfare; temporal basis and double-counting must be separately confirmed. Do not divide by 220 as a validated average.

notExtractedSource.material: Local-authority modelled potential eligibility/receipt tables (2023/24) published as ODS, not ingested into HPI
notExtractedSource.reason: Specific Newham row, variable definitions and permissions not yet independently extracted/validated
notExtractedSource.whyDifferent: Administrative potential receipt rate is not comparable to official GB survey-based caseload take-up; classification may be biased by missing savings and housing costs
notExtractedSource.requiredBeforeNumericalComparison: Exact table/row provenance, geography/year/unit, uncertainties, OGL coverage and distinction between household and benefit-unit denominators

researchQuestion: For low-income Newham pension-age households, can an independent and pre-specified evaluation reliably measure confirmed Pension Credit receipt attributable to an ethical incremental improvement over established services?
existingDelivery: Our Newham Money already supports Pension Credit claims; an additional HPI contact campaign is not justified without assessed additionality.
mandatoryGates: Independent methods and community review F0-03.1 #19
Real local eligible population denominator and approved award verification
Independent partner/data controller and information governance
Ethics and safeguarding, no withholding lawful entitlements
Pre-specified comparison, missingness, subgroup, duration and participant time/cost
Quantified additionality over existing Newham delivery
Qualified independent scientific and local legal review
allowedWork: Public metadata and synthetic-only desktop feasibility assessment
reportVersion: case-study desk validation V0.2, not approved F0-03 scientific V1.0
